name: Bandhan
tagline: Two salaries. One shared life. Zero money friction.
prompt: A shared money app for couples in Mumbai to plan rent, savings goals and weekend spends together

spec.name: Bandhan
spec.world: Karan, a UX copywriter, and Ananya, a marketing lead, live together in Bandra West, Mumbai. They are tracking ₹1,48,500 total monthly pool. Rent of ₹65,000 for their 2BHK is due on the 1st. They are saving for an Alibaug weekend getaway (target ₹35,000, currently at ₹28,500) and have an active ₹5,000 budget for Subko Coffee visits and weekend dining.

imagery.subject: A sunny, plant-filled Mumbai apartment balcony with two steel coffee mugs sitting on a small wooden table next to a shared budget planner
A couple enjoying a ferry ride to Alibaug, smiling with the Mumbai coast in the background
An close-up of hands typing on a phone to split a bill at a stylish Bandra cafe
A minimalist map illustration of South Mumbai and Bandra connected by the Sea Link, highlighting key weekend spend hotspots

spec.summary: A modern collaborative ledger designed for couples in Mumbai to pool their funds, sync on monthly rent, track their Alibaug weekend savings, and auto-split daily Bandra cafe spends without the awkward math.
spec.tagline: Two salaries. One shared life. Zero money friction.
spec.audience: Young working couples, live-in partners, and newlyweds in Mumbai managing joint household expenses

directions.why: It's the most natural, trusted pattern for managing money. It gives a sense of stability and institutional trust with clean lines and readable numeric values.
directions.twist: A 'Calm Monsoon' palette of deep slate, warm ivory, and soft seafoam green, utilizing beautiful Indian-styled currency typography that highlights Rupee symbols with premium elegance.

directions.why: This is a relationship app as much as a financial one. A soft, tactile, human approach reduces the tension and anxiety that couples often feel when discussing budgets.
directions.twist: Using textured cream backdrops resembling handmade paper from Maharashtra, rounded organic progress rings, and hand-drawn interface icons that feel warm and domestic.

directions.why: Perfect for couples who want high-efficiency tracking. The structured grid helps present complex split ratios and ledger sheets without any visual clutter.
directions.twist: A high-contrast grid system using bold black lines, monospaced numbers for transactions, and bright safety orange accents inspired by Mumbai's iconic local trains and taxi indicators.

spec.heroObject: The combined monthly balance and shared goal progress rings

directions.why: It's the most natural, trusted pattern for managing money. It gives a sense of stability and institutional trust with clean lines and readable numeric values.
directions.name: Calm Monsoon
directions.pitch: A reassuring financial interface for couples, combining deep slate-blue anchors with clean Indian currency styling to make mutual money effortless and trusted.
directions.twist: A 'Calm Monsoon' palette of deep slate, warm ivory, and soft seafoam green, utilizing beautiful Indian-styled currency typography that highlights Rupee symbols with premium elegance.
directions.motion: Reassuring: number count-ups and quiet 300ms transitions that emphasize precision and safety without bouncy distraction.
directions.imagery: Minimalist digital brand marks or clean letter tiles representing joint merchants. No distracting illustrations, just razor-sharp financial charts.
signature: A deep slate pool card displaying a high-precision joint balance
Tabular monospaced decimals aligned in a daily grouped ledger
A clear single-sentence progress insight displayed above savings targets

directions.why: Perfect for couples who want high-efficiency tracking. The structured grid helps present complex split ratios and ledger sheets without any visual clutter.
directions.name: Bandra Local
directions.pitch: A hard-edged, ultra-rational shared ledger employing asymmetric structural grids and high-contrast indicators for frictionless expense management.
directions.twist: A high-contrast grid system using bold black lines, monospaced numbers for transactions, and bright safety orange accents inspired by Mumbai's iconic local trains and taxi indicators.
directions.motion: No animation ease-outs; mechanical, raw 150ms structural transitions that jump instantly into place along gridlines.
directions.imagery: No illustration or decoration. Pure black and white raw crops of urban geometries and local transit textures.
signature: Oversized typographic metrics flush-left and tightly compressed
Rigid 1px black outline cells grouping real-time transactional balances
A single, striking blast of signal orange to pull focus to actions
